metadata.name: ahe_evolve
metadata.description: Run the AHE Evolution Agent stages 1-3 (observe, diagnose, propose). Dry-run by default — no mutation.

corpus_key.description: Corpus key to aggregate telemetry for. Default "default".

parent_skeleton:
# invoke(ahe_evolve, args)

Runs the first three stages of the AHE Evolution Agent loop:

1. **Observe** — aggregates telemetry from the event system into `ahe:telemetry:{cycle}`
2. **Diagnose** — delegates to `harness_engineer` subagent to attribute problems to harness components, stores `ahe:diagnosis:{cycle}`
3. **Propose** — delegates to `harness_engineer` subagent to generate candidate revisions with governance tiers, stores `ahe:proposal:{proposal_id}`

Dry-run by default. No mutation of harness config. Stages 4-5 (evaluate, promote) are separate.

ahe_evolve.name: ahe_evolve
ahe_evolve.description: Runs the first three stages (observe, diagnose, propose) of the AHE Evolution Agent loop without mutating harness config

corpus_key.description: Corpus key to aggregate telemetry for. Default "default".

telemetry_key.description: Blackboard key ahe:telemetry:{cycle} containing aggregated telemetry

diagnosis_key.description: Blackboard key ahe:diagnosis:{cycle} containing attributed problem diagnosis

proposal_key.description: Blackboard key ahe:proposal:{proposal_id} containing candidate revisions with governance tiers

side_effects: spawns harness_engineer subagent for diagnosis and proposal stages
preconditions: event system available with telemetry data
postconditions: no harness config mutation (dry-run by default)

error_conditions.recovery_hint: ensure event system is running and has data for the specified corpus_key and window_days

error_conditions.output_shape: partial blackboard state with telemetry_key but no diagnosis_key or proposal_key
error_conditions.recovery_hint: check subagent availability and retry from the failed stage
